organization.description: SonarCloud organisation. Default: sonar.organization from sonar-project.properties.

project-key.description: SonarCloud project key. Default: sonar.projectKey from sonar-project.properties.

SONAR_TOKEN.description: SonarCloud token. Optional so that a missing secret is classified by the preflight instead of failing at startup.

class.description: Preflight classification (ok, secrets-withheld, token-absent, token-rejected, organization-missing, project-missing, project-forbidden, project-org-mismatch, config-missing, config-invalid, server-unavailable).

steps.name: Assert this reusable's own commit resolved
steps.run:
if ! printf '%s' "$SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'; then
  echo "::error::job.workflow_sha resolved to '${SELF_WORKFLOW_SHA:-<empty>}', not a 40-hex commit, so the preflight helper would come from standards' default branch."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Checkout standards for the preflight helper

with.args: ${{ inputs.organization != '' && format('-Dsonar.organization={0}', inputs.organization) || '' }} ${{ inputs.project-key != '' && format('-Dsonar.projectKey={0}', inputs.project-key) || '' }}
